question: Choose the correct spelling of the word meaning 'difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious'.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word meaning 'difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious' is **'enigmatic.'**
 
• **Correct spelling:** Enigmatic.
 
• The other options are incorrect spellings of the word.
 
• **Definition:** Enigmatic means mysterious, puzzling, or hard to interpret.
 
• **Example:** The Mona Lisa's smile is often described as enigmatic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Incorrect Options:**
 
 
• **Inigmatic:** This is an incorrect spelling.
 
• **Anigmatic:** This is also an incorrect spelling.
 
• **Enigmattic:** This is a misspelled version with an extra 't'.
